name: Haichao (Hychao) Wang
title: Master Student
focus: Video AI(Efficiency, Understanding and Generation), Machine Learning
about: Hi there! I am a master's student in Data Science and Information Technology at Tsinghua University, advised by Prof. Yuxing Han. My current research centers on video perception, video understanding, generative modeling, and efficiency.

I received my bachelor's degree in Computer Science and Technology from Beijing Jiaotong University in 2023. In 2023/01-2023/08, I was a Research Intern at the Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences (CASIA), advised by Prof. Ziyu Jia, working on multimodal physiological time-series modeling. In 2025/10-2026/08, I was collaborating with Prof. Kyriakos Flouris at the University of Cambridge on human motion generative modeling
I am always open to research discussions and collaborations. Feel free to get in touch!

experience.title: Long Video Understanding and Memory System
experience.desc: Developing a long video understanding and memory system.

experience.title: Generative Human Motion Mimicking
experience.desc: Developed an algorithm using diffusion trajectory matching for controlled long-range motion generation.

experience.title: Efficient Video Computer Vision with Motion Estimation
experience.desc: Applied video motion estimation to accelerate video computer vision systems and proposed an efficient Bayer-data pipeline that removes ISP latency.
